'''FK Tekstilac Odžaci''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Текстилац Оџаци}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Odžaci]], [[Vojvodina]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Serbian First League]], the second tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]."}}
